statement: Bounded terminal successor to benchmark-whole-topology-resource-accounting after the independently landed Docker observation split: the exact remaining candidate preserves every original C4 matrix, digest-root, paired-effect, whole-architecture, immutable-price, and harness-fidelity contract and produces three consecutive live-calibrated reports with durable fresh-process replay, terminal C3 capacity evidence, complete topology accounting, verified cleanup, and source provenance bound to the landed base plus exact delta.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Do not seal this Quest until benchmark-statistical-capacity-protocol is terminal.

Own the shared immutable Cartesian matrix manifest, resource-window join, and per-cell evidence envelope consumed by C5, C6, C8, C9, and C10. Reject missing, duplicate, or extra cells; bind each capacity sample to its matrix, cell, pair, run, semantic receipt, live-engagement receipt, and resource window; require every sealed cell to be valid or explicitly non-measuring; and retain sourceRevision, producedAt, validUntil, and exact price-sheet validity for later eligibility checks.

Define one authoritative content-addressed root envelope and exact artifact manifest for comparative matrix evidence. Validation must resolve digests to bounded raw bytes through a sealed resolver contract, re-hash and parse canonical schemas, reject missing, duplicate, extra, relocated, cyclic, oversized, or tampered artifacts, and never trust caller-supplied paths or already-parsed validation flags.

Each measuring cell exposes independently recomputable paired capacity and cost effects. Each effect binds side IDs, numerator and denominator convention, raw values, immutable units, estimate, confidence interval, practical threshold, sample count, and every source digest; capacity is higher-is-better, cost per million correct SLO-eligible operations is lower-is-better, and neither may be inferred from caller-supplied result or claim text.

Fixed-resource and fixed-SLO comparisons include every architecture-specific component, provisioned and utilized units, amplification, IOPS, network and inter-zone traffic, minimum footprint, and headroom.

Cost per million correct operations is a separate projection from immutable measured units using a versioned region, date, currency, billing, reservation, and exclusion contract without double counting.
Apply the harness-fidelity attack checklist and calibrate synthetic byte and resource counters at live transport, storage, and process seams with immutable raw artifacts.
